lines.name: Raven Rock
lines.about: Jobs for the people of Raven Rock, the town on Solstheim: two stories for the town's council and guard, a trip to the bottom of Raven Rock Mine for Crescius Caerellius, and small favors for townsfolk. The records give no level gate for the line; the toughest named foes are General Falx Carius at level 43 and the level 120 boss of Raven Rock Mine.

getIn.where: the Attius Farm, outside Raven Rock on Solstheim
getIn.how: Come upon Captain Veleth fighting ash spawn at the Attius Farm, kill them, then speak to him; he asks you to search the farm for clues.

order.what: You help Captain Veleth against the ash spawn, search the Attius Farm, kill General Falx Carius (level 43) at Fort Frostmoth, and report back to Veleth for a bounty.
order.where: the Attius Farm and Fort Frostmoth, Solstheim

order.what: Adril Arano, Second Councilor, asks you to find the Ulen assassins threatening Councilor Morvayn; the search starts with Geldis Sadri at The Retching Netch, leads to Ashfallow Citadel, and ends back in Raven Rock with Councilor Morvayn.
order.where: Raven Rock and Ashfallow Citadel, Solstheim
order.needs: Finish March of the Dead; Captain Veleth tells you Adril wants to see you.

order.what: Glover Mallory, Raven Rock's smith, asks you to get his Ancient Nordic Pickaxe back from Crescius Caerellius.

Crescius Caerellius asks you to find his great-grandfather Gratian's remains and journal at the bottom of Raven Rock Mine; the way out runs through Bloodskal Barrow. The mine's records list the dragon priest Zahkriisos, level 120, as its boss.
order.where: Raven Rock Mine and Bloodskal Barrow

order.what: A side objective that appears during The Final Descent: slay the Seeker in Bloodskal Barrow.
Captain Veleth asks you to find a hidden stash of Emberbrand Wine in Raven Rock.
Milore Ienth, the alchemist, asks you to collect 5 netch jelly for her.
order.where: Ienth Farm, Raven Rock, and wherever netch are found

order.what: Elder Othreloth asks you to clear the ash spawn out of the Temple's tomb.
Geldis Sadri asks you to hand out 10 free samples of Sadri's Sujamma around Raven Rock.
order.where: Raven Rock and The Retching Netch

order.what: Fethis Alor asks you to find the East Empire Pendants he has lost around Raven Rock.
Bralsa Drel, a beggar barred from The Retching Netch, asks you to convince Geldis Sadri to let her back in.
Cindiri Arano asks you to bring back her folio from the wreck of the Strident Squall.

options: Go straight back to Captain Veleth after killing Carius for the bounty.
Read Carius's letter first and take it to a guard, then to Veleth; the ending is the same.
Return the Ancient Nordic Pickaxe to Glover, who pays you.
Tell Glover a lie about the pickaxe; what that changes isn't in the records.

gives: A gold bounty from Captain Veleth (March of the Dead)
Bloodskal Blade, a greatsword that releases an energy blast on power attacks (The Final Descent)
Forge recipe: Bloodskal Blade Replica, needing Ebony Smithing (after The Final Descent)
Gold from some of the favors (An Axe to Find, The Final Descent, Pain in the Necklace)
closes: General Falx Carius dies in March of the Dead
Vendil Severin dies in Served Cold

unsure.why: No level gate or time to finish is in the records; the levels given are those of single foes and places.

Served Cold's reward isn't decoded. A LoreRim patch named for Severin Manor having a price edits the quest and Councilor Morvayn's thank-you line; that points to Severin Manor being sold rather than given, but the records here don't show the price or the hand-over.

An Axe to Find is named as the lead-in to The Final Descent and Crescius is in both, but the records don't show it starting The Final Descent. What starts The Final Descent Priest isn't shown either, and whether the Seeker is Zahkriisos isn't settled.
Served Cold's need for March of the Dead is read from Adril Arano's line about everything you've already done for Raven Rock; the condition on Captain Veleth's opening line isn't in the files.
The conditions on the favor givers' opening lines aren't in the files, so whether March of the Dead or anything else must come first for the favors isn't known.
Gold amounts aren't in the records. Most favors list no reward at all; whether you pick up the Bloodskal Blade or are handed it isn't shown.
What happens to Tilisu and Mirri Severin in Served Cold isn't in the records.

lines.name: Thirsk Mead Hall
lines.about: The story of Thirsk Mead Hall on Solstheim's eastern shore, which rieklings have taken from the Nords who lived there. You help either the Nords take it back or the rieklings drive the Nords off, and the Nords have favors of their own; the records give no level gate.

getIn.where: Bujold's Retreat, the Nords' camp on Solstheim's eastern shore
getIn.how: Talk to Bujold; she tells you rieklings took Thirsk Mead Hall and asks you to join the assault.

order.what: You join the Nords' assault to take Thirsk Mead Hall back from the rieklings, then go with Bujold to Hrothmund's Barrow to seek the blessing of Thirsk's founder.
order.where: Thirsk Mead Hall and Hrothmund's Barrow, Solstheim

order.what: The riekling chief inside Thirsk Mead Hall asks you to help his tribe with favors, starting with giving Bilgemuck some meat.
order.needs: This is the riekling side; helping the rieklings fails Retaking Thirsk.

order.what: Elmus, camped with the Nords, asks you to fetch Ashfire Mead from Thirsk Mead Hall.
order.where: Bujold's Retreat and Thirsk Mead Hall

order.what: Elmus, back in the hall, asks you to bring him some Juniper Berries.
order.needs: The Nords back in Thirsk Mead Hall after Retaking Thirsk.

order.what: Halbarn Iron-Fur, the Nords' smith, asks you to bring him 10 Stalhrim and 15 Ebony Ingots.
order.where: Thirsk Mead Hall, or Bujold's Retreat before the hall is retaken

order.what: Hilund asks you to bring her 50 Riekling Spears.
order.where: Thirsk Mead Hall, or Bujold's Retreat before the hall is retaken

options: Help the Nords retake the hall.
Help the rieklings in The Chief of Thirsk Hall, which fails the Nords' quest and ends with the Nords killed.
Back Bujold when she says she will lead anyway: she lives and starts a new tradition at Thirsk.
Call her leadership a fraud: she attacks you and you have to kill her.

gives: Chief of the Thirsk rieklings, if you take the riekling side
Leveled quest rewards from the Nords' favors (Elmus, Halbarn, Hilund)
closes: Siding with the Nords fails The Chief of Thirsk Hall; siding with the rieklings fails Retaking Thirsk

On the riekling side Bujold, Kuvar, Elmus, Halbarn Iron-Fur, Hilund, Sirkjorg and Herkja are killed, and with them Halbarn's smithing, Kuvar's Heavy Armor training, Elmus's shop, the Nords' favors, and Halbarn and Hilund as marriage partners
Bujold dies if you call her a fraud at Hrothmund's Barrow
The old riekling chief dies on the riekling side

unsure.why: No level gate or time to finish is in the records.
The Unofficial Patch adds an impossible level condition to one of the opening lines, which switches it off; which line and whether it matters isn't in the files.
How you get to talk to the riekling chief without a fight isn't in the files, nor where Bilgemuck is found.

The conditions on the favor offers aren't in the files. The Ashfire Mead favor fits while the Nords are camped and the Juniper Berries one once they are back in the hall, but neither gate is shown, nor the exact condition that blocks the favors on the riekling side.
Retaking Thirsk lists no reward. What the favors' leveled reward lists roll isn't decoded.

lines.name: Neloth of Tel Mithryn
lines.about: Jobs for Neloth, the Telvanni wizard of Tel Mithryn on Solstheim, and the people of his tower: finding his missing steward, settling the new steward's debt, tracking whoever is attacking Neloth, and a set of research errands he offers one at a time. The records give no level gate; Highpoint Tower, where Old Friends leads, is rated for enemies of level 20 to 60.

getIn.where: inside his tower at Tel Mithryn, Solstheim
getIn.how: Talk to Neloth; he asks you to find his steward, Varona Nelas.

order.what: You look for Varona Nelas around Tel Mithryn and along the road to Raven Rock, then recruit Drovas Relvi at The Retching Netch as Neloth's new steward.
Mogrul, a moneylender at The Retching Netch, wants the 1000 septims Drovas owes him, and his man Slitter tells you Mogrul wants a word.
order.needs: Hire Drovas Relvi as the new steward in Reluctant Steward.

order.what: Neloth gives you Neloth's Ring of Tracking to find the source of attacks on him; the trail leads from the Tel Mithryn grounds to Highpoint Tower.
Talvas Fathryon, Neloth's apprentice, asks you to destroy an Ash Guardian he summoned by accident; you can also just come across it on the grounds.
order.needs: If the Dragonborn story is under way, it must have reached Raven Rock telling you of Miraak's temple.

order.what: Elynea Mothren needs three taproots soaked in the Headwaters of Harstrad to heal a withered part of Neloth's tower.
order.where: Tel Mithryn and the Headwaters of Harstrad

order.what: A radiant job: Neloth has found another Black Book in a dungeon the game picks and wants it brought to him.
order.where: a dungeon picked when the job starts

order.what: A radiant job: Neloth wants a heart stone from a mine the game picks.
order.where: a mine picked when the job starts

order.what: Neloth wants a sample of ash from an ash spawn, taken with a special extraction tool.
order.where: wherever you find an ash spawn

order.what: Neloth needs a copy of the book Wind and Sand from a dungeon he names.
Neloth casts an experimental spell on you and wants to hear about its side effects in rain or while swimming.
A second, smaller experiment that shows only as a miscellaneous task: help Neloth with his research.
Neloth asks you to examine a Forsworn Briarheart warrior from the hills on the western edge of Skyrim.
Neloth wants one of Azra Nightwielder's staffs from a dungeon he names.
Elynea Mothren asks you to bring her one of six rare ingredients.

options: Persuade Mogrul to take half, 500 septims.
Refuse and kill Mogrul; until it's settled he keeps sending thugs after you.
Let Neloth cast the spell and report the side effects.

gives: Spell Tome (Expert): Conjure Ash Guardian (From the Ashes)
Talvas Fathryon sells you the spell Neloth was researching (Wind and Sand)
Gold from Neloth's jobs and Elynea's errand
closes: Ildari Sarothril dies in Old Friends
Mogrul dies if you choose to kill him in A New Debt

unsure.why: No level gate or time to finish is in the records.

The conditions on Neloth's opening lines aren't in the files, so whether Reluctant Steward must come before Old Friends isn't shown. The Unofficial Patch moves one of Neloth's line conditions from Old Friends to Reluctant Steward.

Neloth's research jobs and Elynea's errand are offered through a trigger that fires when you change location; its conditions, and the order the jobs come in, aren't in the files. Briarheart Necropsy isn't tied to that trigger, so how it is offered isn't clear.

From the Ashes has a silent early step that waits until the Dragonborn story has reached Raven Rock pointing you to Miraak's temple, or until that story isn't running at all; how that gates Talvas's offer isn't fully shown.
Mogrul's and Ildari Sarothril's last actor records mark them essential, though A New Debt has a 'killed him' ending and Old Friends says to kill Ildari; the files don't show the quests lifting that.

Gold amounts aren't in the records. Whether you keep Neloth's Ring of Tracking isn't shown. The spells and perks on the research jobs' scripts look like parts of the jobs rather than lasting rewards. Azra's Staffs lists no reward. The spell Talvas sells after Wind and Sand isn't named. From the Ashes holds both the Conjure Ash Guardian tome and the spell itself; which you are handed isn't shown.

lines.name: Skaal Village
lines.about: Three jobs for the Skaal of Skaal Village on Solstheim: guarding the historian Tharstan in Vahlok's Tomb, finding the village smith Baldor Iron-Shaper, and carrying a necklace to Falkreath for Morwen. The records give no level gate, but Vahlok's Tomb holds enemies of level 30 to 120.

getIn.where: Skaal Village on Solstheim; he sleeps in the Greathall
getIn.how: Talk to Tharstan; he has found the entrance to an old crypt, offers to hire you as protection and asks you to meet him there.

order.what: You guard Tharstan through Vahlok's Tomb, which has traps and ends with the dragon priest Vahlok the Jailor at level 120.
Deor Woodcutter tells you Baldor Iron-Shaper, the village smith, has gone missing, and you search for him southwest of the village.
order.where: the Abandoned Lodge next to Raven Rock, and Northshore Landing

order.what: Morwen asks you to take Bera's Necklace to Runil in Falkreath, then come back to her.
order.where: the Hall of the Dead in Falkreath, and Skaal Village

gives: Stalhrim crafting: 108 make and improve recipes, nearly all also needing Ebony Smithing (A New Source of Stalhrim)

lines.name: The Black Books
lines.about: Hermaeus Mora's Black Books: reading one pulls you into his realm of Apocrypha, where you look for the book's hidden knowledge, and reading it again lets you escape. A chance encounter in the wilds of Solstheim can point you to a dungeon that holds one; the records give no level gate.

getIn.how: Read "Untold Legends"; it pulls you into Apocrypha and the quest begins.

order.what: A chance encounter while you travel the north, the glaciers or the ashlands of Solstheim tells you which dungeon holds a Black Book.
order.where: a dungeon picked when the encounter fires

order.what: Reading "Untold Legends" pulls you into Apocrypha to learn the book's hidden knowledge.

unsure.why: No level gate or time to finish is in the records.
The files don't say where any of the Black Books lies in the world. The chance encounter's dungeon and book are picked when it fires, and the choices aren't listed.
No conditions on the books or their quests show up, so any gating by the Dragonborn story can't be checked.

The records hold the Black Book powers (Mora's Boon, Omen of Warding, Secret of Arcana, Secret of Protection, Secret of Strength), but nothing in the files ties any of them, or any other reward, to a given book.
Whether a book's quest stays open after you escape by reading it again isn't shown; only the opening and closing log entries exist.
